realizes.rationale: The seven changed lines replace an absolute authorship route with primary-tool-first, same-input-class correct-write recovery; build/route checks, owner notice, manual provenance and remaining permission/validation/transaction stops stay explicit.

15.note: The canonical skill owns artifact types, seat routing, structural routing and converted dispatch.

16.note: Converted-card authorship separates prose, native references, typed entries and current trace rows.

17.note: Normal citation and record writes use their primary tools first. A covered correct-input refusal follows the named same-tool/input-class ladder: retain actual inputs/refusals, verify build and route, notify the owner before a disclosed manual write, keep provenance and working checks, and record the defect. Missing capability and permission, read/check/validation/sync/start or commit gates do not enter that exception.
